entityName: TECHNISCHE UNIVERSITAET DARMSTADT - Physical and Satellite Geodesy
entityDescription:
Work group Physical and Satellite Geodesy (PSGD) under the chair of Geodätische Messsysteme und Sensorik of the Technical University Darmstadt.
PSGD is active in research and teaching of the diverse topics of global geodesy. Among these for example determination of global geodetic coordinate reference systems, globally consistent position determination, research on environmental change with respect to geometry, gravity field, and mass transport in system Earth.
Focal points of our activities are all aspects of Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS), applications of Satellite Geodesy, multi-sensor systems with inclusion of microwave interferometry with application in civil and environmental engineering, precise navigation based on GNSS/INS systems, e.g. for automotive application, and development of tailored estimation and filtering methods.

entityDescription:
MONTFORT Laser develops and manufactures extremely compact pulsed DPSSL lasers that deliver performance unmatched at their form factor, with excellent long-term stability. The M-NANO series of compact Nd:YAG nanosecond lasers generates pulse energies exceeding 200 mJ from a palm-sized laser head, serving applications such as LIBS, PIV, LIF, photoacoustics, and LIDT testing. Our core expertise lies in making high-energy nanosecond lasers exceptionally compact, robust, and lightweight relative to their energy and peak power output.
As an example, the M-NANO model PR193 — weighing approximately 2 kg — is a fully self-contained nanosecond laser: no external boxes, no chiller, no water cooling. Simply connect 24 VDC power (a laptop-style supply is included), provide your commands and triggers, and the system is ready to pulse. The entire M-NANO series is optimized for low power consumption, high beam quality, and long operational lifetime.
MONTFORT Laser also offers precision and high laser damage IBS coatings through its NANEO brand.

entityDescription:
The Nicosia District Local Government Organization, is a newly constituted Local Government Authority established under the District Organizations of Local Government Law of 2022. The Organization now serves as the central authority responsible for key public service functions in the Nicosia District.
The Organization consolidates and coordinates critical services previously delivered by multiple local authorities, enhancing cohesion, efficiency and the overall quality of services provided to citizens.
Within its remit, the Organization is responsible for the following sectors:
•Water Supply:Distribution of water, management and maintenance of water networks, ensuring water quality, installation of modern GLS tanks, telemetry systems and smart water metering.
•Sewerage:Creation and integrated operation of the sewage system across the District.
•Stormwater Management:Design and implementation of flood-protection projects tailored to the needs of the District and its communities.
•Development Permitting:Receipt, assessment and issuance of building and development permits using modern digital procedures for the benefit of citizens.
•Solid Waste Management:Supervision and operation of Green Points, along with the management of special and bulky waste.
In addition, the Organization is responsible for the planning and implementation of infrastructure projects, including GLS water tanks, sewage system development and the establishment of new Green Points.
The mission of the Organization is focused on the continuous improvement of public service delivery and the development of a modern and sustainable District. In this context, the strategy and planning of the Nicosia District Local Government Organization are fully aligned with the policies, priorities and objectives of the European Union on sustainable development, as set out in the European Green Deal and the EU Circular Economy Action Plan. Particularemphasis is placed on the efficient use of natural resources, environmental protection and the strengthening of infrastructure resilience at local level.
At the same time, the Organization integrates the principles of the circular economy into the design and implementation of its policies, with a focus on waste prevention, reuse and the rational management of materials and resources. Through the operation and expansion of Green Points, modern solid waste management practices, water resource conservation and the deployment of smart and digital technologies, the Organization actively contributes to the transition towards a sustainable, efficient and environmentally responsible model of local governance, fully aligned with the European regulatory framework.
The Organization seeks to develop cooperation with international institutions and NGOs that share common principles and objectives, with the aim of exchanging expertise and implementing initiatives that benefit the residents of the District.

entityDescription:
cepezedbouwteam
realizes designs in direct collaboration with building partners. We monitor the starting points for budget and planning and coordinate the optimal implementation of the design. The process and all its steps are always fully transparent for the client.

cepezedbouwteam can be deployed as the connecting link between the design and implementation of projects designed by cepezed and other architects. On behalf of the client, we organize the tendering, work preparation and execution of all work tasks. We combine this with carrying out building management. Our way of working has significant advantages: process continuity, maximum quality and financial transparency. Shorter turnaround time is also an important plus.

coordination without main contractor
We organize and coordinate the construction without the intervention of a main contractor. For this purpose, we divide the implementation into separately tendered sub-contracts, so that we can select the construction partners directly and carefully on the basis of knowledge, price and quality. Whenever possible, we make the selection before the design is completed, so that we can move forward quickly when it is ready. This way of working fits in well with cepezed’s specific design philosophy, where buildings are realized as prefabricated building kits.

financial transparency
In each phase of tendering and implementation, we continually compare the actual construction costs against the design estimates. This enables us to anticipate both positive and negative financial developments in a timely and effective manner. The client has continuous financial insight and ultimately decides on all sub-tasks and expenses themself.

optimum knowledge-sharing and collaboration
Our way of working guarantees direct cooperation between the designers and construction partners. The designers continue to be involved and all knowledge of the specific issues is fully retained and can be used for the detail engineering. The designers and construction partners work together on the basis of complete and transparent provision of information. This results in optimal quality and a more efficient construction process. cepezedbouwteam brings all the parties together and coordinates the collaboration.

entityDescription:
NAIDER is an independent consulting and applied research organization specializing in sustainable development, ecological transition, innovation, and territorial competitiveness. Founded in 2004, NAIDER supports public administrations, research organizations, technology centers, companies, and international institutions in the design, implementation, and evaluation of strategies, policies, and projects that contribute to economic, environmental, and social transformation. 
Our multidisciplinary team combines expertise in economic analysis, innovation systems, climate action, circular economy, urban and territorial regeneration, sustainability assessment, and public policy design. We develop evidence-based solutions through strategic planning, impact assessment, foresight, monitoring systems, stakeholder engagement, and knowledge transfer activities. 
NAIDER has extensive experience in European and international projects, collaborating with regional and local governments, universities, technology centers, business associations, and innovation ecosystems. We contribute to the development of data-driven methodologies, decision-support tools, and collaborative governance models that address complex societal challenges and accelerate the transition towards a more sustainable and resilient future. 
Headquartered in the Basque Country (Spain), with offices in Bilbao, Donostia-San Sebastián and Valencia, NAIDER operates at local, regional, national, and European levels, providing technical excellence and practical solutions for transformation processes across territories and sectors.

entityDescription:
ANOX AS is a Norwegian deep-tech company developing a reliability intelligence for unmanned remotely operated systems. The company helps engineers identify, understand, and troubleshoot failures faster by combining telemetry, logs, system knowledge, operational history, and contextual information into a unified diagnostic workflow.
ANOX's technology is designed to provide engineers with actionable insights into what happened, why it happened, and potential paths to resolution. Beyond troubleshooting individual incidents, the platform aims to identify recurring failure patterns across fleets, reduce engineering effort and downtime, and support data-driven decisions related to system design, operations, and reliability improvement.
The technology has been initially validated in unmanned aerial and underwater vehicles (UAVs and ROVs). ANOX is now expanding the approach to additional industries, including the space sector, where increasing system complexity and growing fleet sizes create a need for more scalable diagnostic and reliability capabilities.

entityName: NTT DATA Europe & Latam Green Engineering SLU
entityDescription:
Green Deal & Sustainable Engineering - Innovating for a sustainable future
We provide technology solutions and consulting services to support the transition toward a resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible model.
Our future depends on the health of the planet. For the first time in history, governments, businesses, the financial sector, and civil society are aligned around a shared objective: achieving low-carbon, resilient, and inclusive development.
The Paris Agreement and the 2030 Agenda set the global framework for action on sustainability, climate change, and environmental protection. These initiatives define ambitious goals that enable organizations and citizens to benefit from a green transition.
At NTT DATA, we support our clients throughout their ecological transition, contributing to a fair, prosperous society and a modern, competitive economy.
Our Service Lines
- Climate Change & Corporate Sustainability
We help clients adapt their operations to a more sustainable and low-carbon model through carbon footprint calculation and reporting, risk and vulnerability analysis, and the design of reduction, offsetting, and carbon market strategies.

- Sustainable Construction
We promote energy-efficient buildings developed under sustainable criteria, contributing to energy savings of up to 50–70%, and supporting certifications such as LEED, BREEAM, and WELL, as well as nearly zero-energy buildings (NZEB).

- Circular Economy
We integrate circularity across the value chain by analyzing life cycles (LCA), identifying key factors, and designing strategies and action plans that ensure sustainable and efficient business models.

- Environment, Biodiversity & Natural Capital
We assess environmental impacts on biodiversity, evaluate natural capital, and define strategies and action plans focused on preserving ecosystems and managing environmental and social risks.

- Energy Efficiency & Energy Transition
We conduct energy audits, develop renewable energy plans, support consumption reduction initiatives, and monitor performance through innovative management dashboards.

- Water
We deliver water engineering and aquatic ecology services, analyzing water cycle infrastructures and applying technology to support the protection and preservation of water resources.

- Sustainable Mobility
We provide solutions for public transport systems, low-emission zone management, and road safety, addressing the environmental impact of mobility in high-demand areas.

- Green IT
We support organizations in adopting green technologies through a Green Computing approach that enhances efficiency while reducing environmental impact.

- Primary Sector
We offer consulting and digitalization services for aquaculture, fisheries, and agribusiness, promoting a more innovative, efficient, and competitive primary sector.

- Smart Cities
We design and implement sustainable and digital transformation plans for cities, covering areas such as energy, pollution, biodiversity, and resource efficiency, while supporting access to funding.

entityDescription:
We are an innovative biotechnology manufacturer specializing in advanced biomaterials and emergency wound care solutions. Our core expertise lies in developing multi-functional, chitosan-based hydrogels designed to operate effectively in high-stress, resource-limited, and austere environments.
Our flagship technology, NovaHemo, is a biocompatible medical dressing that actively promotes platelet aggregation for rapid hemostasis, provides broad-spectrum antimicrobial action (including efficacy against S. aureus and E. coli), and accelerates the healing of acute trauma, surgical wounds, and thermal burns.
In the context of aerospace medicine and long-duration spaceflight, our research and development focus is aligned with optimizing Mass, Volume, and Power (MVP) constraints for onboard medical kits. Our hydrogel addresses critical spaceflight challenges by offering passive bioadhesion—eliminating the need for sustained manual compression—and operating as a zero-particulate material, thereby mitigating contamination risks to spacecraft Environmental Control and Life Support Systems (ECLSS).
Our primary objective within the space sector is to collaborate with the European Space Agency and academic partners to validate our technology's fluid dynamics and adhesion capabilities in microgravity. By advancing our Technology Readiness Level (TRL) through parabolic flight testing and ground-based facilities, we aim to provide next-generation, autonomous trauma care solutions for orbital, lunar, and deep-space exploration architectures.

description:
UniVirtua offers dashAlpha 
dashAlpha is an advanced software-defined networking platform with a focus on intelligent, seamless, resilient and secure network access across a multitude of bearer technologies – whilst being simple and easy to use. Our ‘zero touch’ philosophy with regard to user interaction has resulted in a platform with a simple user interface and a high level of automation to deliver a secure, high-bandwidth network access connection with minimal effort. dashAlpha enables a user to gain network access by simultaneously using different technologies – such as 5G, LTE, WiFi and satellite – to create a single high-bandwidth and secure connection which is resilient to drop-outs and other network failures. In achieving this, dashAlpha is able to not only deliver high bandwidth for streaming services such as Netflix and YouTube but to also deliver seamless network connectivity for communications applications such as WhatsApp, Skype, Teams and Zoom. Additionally, the software-defined nature of dashAlpha enables it to run on a variety of COTS (Commercial-off-the-Shelf) hardware, enabling flexible deployment options.

Meteoclim Services SL is a Spain-based SME specializing in advanced meteorological and climate intelligence solutions. The company focuses on transforming atmospheric and environmental data into actionable insights, developing cutting-edge tools that support decision-making in weather forecasting, climate resilience, and risk assessment.
With expertise in meteorology, data science, and information technology, Meteoclim designs and delivers innovative solutions aimed at enhancing weather monitoring, forecasting accuracy, and climate adaptation strategies. Its work encompasses high-resolution climate modeling and the development of early warning systems to mitigate the impacts of extreme weather events.
A strong emphasis on research and technological innovation enables the integration of satellite observations, numerical models, and artificial intelligence into precise, user-friendly solutions. These solutions are tailored to industries such as agriculture, energy, transportation, and emergency management. The company maintains a commitment to scientific excellence and practical application, ensuring that its products support data-driven decision-making with confidence.
Climate intelligence is a key factor in building a more resilient and sustainable future. Through collaboration with research institutions, public agencies, and private sector partners, Meteoclim continuously enhances its capabilities to develop robust, intuitive, and impactful meteorological solutions. Its expertise in climate analytics, predictive modeling, and user-centered design positions the company as a trusted leader in the field of applied meteorology and climate services

entityDescription:
Questa is building a new category of enterprise technology: a Decision Intelligence and Agentic AI ecosystem that enables organizations to build and scale AI safely, responsibly, and effectively. 

The company's philosophy is simple: before AI can make decisions, automate workflows, or act autonomously, the underlying data must first be made safe.
The journey starts with privacy-by-design. Through Questa's own proprietary Blackbox technology, sensitive information is automatically identified, anonymized, and protected before being exposed to large language models or AI agents. Names, financial details, personal identifiers, confidential business information, and regulated data can be redacted and replaced with secure placeholders, ensuring organizations maintain control of their information while still benefiting from modern AI capabilities. This approach is particularly valuable for financial institutions, healthcare providers, legal firms, government agencies, and other highly regulated sectors.
Once data is protected, organizations can move beyond experimentation and begin building enterprise-scale AI systems. Questa Solutions helps clients create agentic workflows, decision support systems, AI copilots, and autonomous business processes that integrate directly with existing applications, knowledge repositories, and operational systems. The result is a platform that transforms fragmented data into trusted intelligence and actionable outcomes.
Practical examples include privacy-protected investment research for fund managers, secure M&A due diligence workflows, intelligent document analysis for legal teams, healthcare knowledge assistants that preserve patient confidentiality, and enterprise agents that automate compliance, reporting, and operational decision-making. These solutions enable organizations to accelerate productivity while maintaining GDPR compliance, governance, and auditability.
By combining data protection, decision science, workflow automation, and agentic AI, Questa Solutions provides a scalable foundation for the next generation of intelligent enterprises. Rather than asking organizations to choose between innovation and compliance, the platform makes privacy, security, and governance the starting point for AI-driven transformation.

entityDescription:
Flexible Power Systems (FPS) is a UK-based technology and services company dedicated to accelerating the transition to electric vehicle (EV) fleets through data-driven solutions. The company combines advanced software with deep operational expertise to help organisations confidently plan, deploy and scale electrification strategies while managing cost, risk and performance.
At the core of FPS’s offering is a suite of intelligent tools and services that support every stage of the EV journey. From early-stage transition planning through to large-scale fleet operation, FPS provides strategic consulting, detailed data analysis and practical engineering insight to ensure informed decision-making. Its approach helps businesses assess EV suitability, design optimal rollout plans and maximise the return on investment from electrification initiatives. 
FPS’s proprietary platform, Operate, enables real-time visibility of electric fleets, integrating vehicle tracking, smart charging optimisation and charger management alongside advanced operational analytics. This scalable system is designed to grow with fleets, supporting everything from initial pilots to full-scale deployments, while unlocking efficiencies through automation, energy optimisation and charger sharing. 
In addition, FPS offers targeted solutions such as TRU Fuel Saver, which helps reduce emissions and operating costs from transport refrigeration units by switching from diesel to electric power. This innovation reflects the company’s broader mission to improve sustainability while delivering measurable commercial benefits. 
Since pioneering new approaches to fleet electrification in 2018, FPS has worked with leading organisations to deliver real-world results. With a team experienced in both energy systems and commercial transport, the company bridges the gap between strategy and execution—empowering clients to transition to cleaner, smarter and more efficient transport operations with confidence.

entityDescription:
At XelerateVR, we're solving one of VR’s biggest hurdles – locomotion – with our next-level VR treadmills that significantly enhance the gaming & training experience, while also combating motion sickness.
VR is so immersive because it lets you use your own body to interact with the virtual world instead of relying on joysticks and buttons.
But when it comes to movement, we’re still stuck with joysticks - like we’re still working with some flat screen.
This isn’t the true promise of VR.
It was long overdue that someone developed a proper VR treadmill - one that provides a realistic walking sensation and transmits the user’s movements to VR with maximum accuracy.
The result: next-level immersion and a solution to motion sickness that finally unlocks a ton of enterprise use-case, including astronaut training and many more.
